author: Sp4rrkii
body:
Here is my 2nd latest map called Sahandus which has been released and its a little more interesting than others. It is a DTM+CTW combo which in my memory is only the 2nd one to be made (Inspiration was from Cuish's dtm+ctw map). This map is one of my favourites so far and i hope it'll get accepted, so now lets move over to the details. 
Details

Team Colours: Lime vs Orange

Team Sizes: 18v18 max 2v2 min

Build time: 4-6 hours

(Note: FlashFireK also deserves some credit for helping base the wall pattern structure aswell as helping the first build stages such as the Spawn area.

Authors: Zalatoh and FlashFireK

Pictures/Album - http://imgur.com/gallery/MBZwB

As i said hope this gets accepted as it is quite a unique gamemode because it has only ever been made once. The gameplay will be new and very interesting to watch if this gets played. Constructive feedback would be welcomed and make sure you tell everyone else about it so i can get lots of people's feedback.
